section_summary: This section records proposed visits by Japanese naval transports, a cruiser, a minelayer and a training squadron to ports in the Philippine Islands from 1935 to 1937. The Japanese Embassy supplied schedules and requested customary courtesies; the State, War and Navy Departments coordinated responses. The correspondence also records a canceled visit, a delayed arrival and a request for training squadron personnel to visit the naval base at Cavite.

subfiles.title: Proposed visit of transport Ondo: notice to War Department
subfiles.about: Ondo was expected at Manila on October 11–13 while carrying crude petroleum.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War perceives no objection.

subfiles.title: Proposed visit of transport Ondo: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Ondo was expected at Manila on October 11–13 while carrying crude petroleum.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if Navy perceives no objection.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Ondo
subfiles.about: War arranged customary courtesies for Ondo's Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to the Philippine Department and notice to the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Navy Department response on Ondo
subfiles.from: W. H. Standley, Acting Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Navy raised no objection to Ondo's Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports that naval authorities at Manila have been notified.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for transport Sata
subfiles.about: A Japanese transport sought to replenish coal, water and food at Manila on March 8–11.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval and customary courtesies; the vessel's name is corrected to Sata in a later note.

subfiles.title: Sata visit: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Sata, commanded by Captain Teizaburo Fukuda, proposed a Manila replenishment visit.
subfiles.summary: Relays the itinerary and possible weather changes; War is asked to arrange courtesies.

subfiles.title: Sata visit: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Sata proposed a Manila replenishment visit on March 8–11.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgment of Sata visit
subfiles.about: State accepted Sata's proposed Manila visit and consulted other departments.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the schedule and possible weather delays, states that the visit is agreeable to the State Department, and reports consultation on customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Correction of transport name to Sata
subfiles.about: The Embassy corrected the transport's name from Sagara to Sata.
subfiles.summary: Corrects the name in the February 14 note.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Sata
subfiles.about: War instructed Philippine authorities to extend courtesies to Sata.
subfiles.summary: Reports a cable to Manila and referral for notice to the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Navy Department response on Sata
subfiles.about: Navy raised no objection to Sata's Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Naval commanders were notified; port authorities should receive prompt notice of weather delays.

subfiles.title: Further notice to Japanese Ambassador on Sata
subfiles.about: Authorities were notified to extend customary courtesies to Sata.
subfiles.summary: Reports the departments' replies and asks for prompt port notification if weather delays the ship.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for cruiser Yubari
subfiles.about: Yubari, commanded by Rear Admiral Boshiro Hosogaya, proposed to visit Iloilo on May 24–25.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval for the visit and crew landing, with customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Yubari visit: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Yubari proposed to visit Iloilo on May 24–25.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War has no objection.

subfiles.title: Yubari visit: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Yubari proposed to visit Iloilo under Rear Admiral Boshiro Hosogaya.
subfiles.summary: Relays the itinerary and War Department request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgment of Yubari visit
subfiles.about: State found Yubari's Iloilo visit agreeable.
subfiles.summary: Reports consultation with other federal departments concerning customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Yubari
subfiles.about: War arranged courtesies for Yubari's Iloilo visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to the Philippine Department and notice for the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for transport Erimo
subfiles.about: Erimo, commanded by Captain Masaki Ogata, proposed to visit Davao on May 15–18.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval for the oil transport's visit and crew landing, allowing for weather changes.

subfiles.title: Erimo visit: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Erimo proposed to visit Davao while transporting crude oil.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War has no objection.

subfiles.title: Erimo visit: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Erimo proposed to visit Davao on May 15–18.
subfiles.summary: Relays the visit and War Department request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgment of Erimo visit
subfiles.about: State accepted Erimo's Davao visit and addressed possible weather changes.
subfiles.summary: Reports consultation with other departments about customary courtesies. State understands weather changes to the schedule as delays in arrival.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Erimo
subfiles.about: War instructed Philippine authorities to extend courtesies to Erimo.
subfiles.summary: Reports a cable to Manila and referral for notice to the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for Ondo
subfiles.about: Ondo, commanded by Captain Michiaki Kamada, proposed to visit Manila on October 30–November 1.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies for the oil transport and notes possible weather changes.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgment of Ondo visit
subfiles.about: State consulted federal authorities about Ondo's proposed Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the itinerary and reports consultation on customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Ondo visit: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Ondo proposed to visit Manila on October 30–November 1.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War has no objection.

subfiles.title: Ondo visit: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Ondo proposed to visit Manila while carrying crude oil.
subfiles.summary: Relays the itinerary and War Department request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Ondo
subfiles.about: War arranged courtesies for Ondo's proposed Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to the Philippine Department and notice for the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy cancellation of Ondo visit
subfiles.about: The planned October–November visit of Ondo to Manila was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Requests that concerned U.S. authorities be informed.

subfiles.title: Ondo cancellation: notice to War Department
subfiles.about: State notified War that Ondo's Manila visit was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese Ambassador's cancellation note.

subfiles.title: Ondo cancellation: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: State notified Navy that Ondo's Manila visit was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese Ambassador's cancellation note.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Ondo cancellation
subfiles.about: Federal authorities were advised that Ondo's Manila visit was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the Embassy's cancellation notice.

subfiles.title: Navy Department response on proposed Ondo visit
subfiles.from: W. H. Standley, Acting Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Navy had raised no objection to Ondo's proposed visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to local naval officials; the letter predates the cancellation notice.

subfiles.title: War Department acknowledgment of Ondo cancellation
subfiles.about: War passed Ondo's cancellation to Philippine authorities.
subfiles.summary: Reports a cable to the Philippine Department and referral for notice to the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for Sata and Erimo
subfiles.about: Sata proposed to visit Davao and Erimo Manila for replenishment.
subfiles.summary: Gives late November and early December schedules, names Commanders Kunizo Mori and Motoji Nakamura, and requests customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Sata and Erimo visits: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Sata and Erimo proposed replenishment visits to Davao and Manila.
subfiles.summary: Relays both schedules and War Department request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Sata and Erimo visits: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Sata and Erimo proposed replenishment visits to Davao and Manila.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War has no objection.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgment of Sata and Erimo visits
subfiles.about: State consulted federal authorities about the Sata and Erimo visits.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges both replenishment schedules and reports consultation on customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Sata and Erimo
subfiles.about: War instructed Philippine authorities to extend courtesies to both transports.
subfiles.summary: Reports a cable to Manila and referral for notice to the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Navy Department response on Sata and Erimo
subfiles.from: W. H. Standley, Acting Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Navy raised no objection to the Sata and Erimo visits.
subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to local naval authorities to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for December Ondo visit
subfiles.about: Ondo proposed a December 15–16 Manila replenishment visit.
subfiles.summary: Names Captain Tokusaburo Ozumi and requests approval and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: December Ondo visit: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Ondo proposed to replenish fuel, food and water at Manila.
subfiles.summary: Confirms a December 10 telephone communication and reports the request to War for courtesies.

subfiles.title: State Department approval of December Ondo visit
subfiles.about: The December Ondo visit was agreeable to U.S. authorities.
subfiles.summary: Confirms that customary courtesies and facilities will be extended.

subfiles.title: December Ondo visit: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Ondo proposed a December 15–16 Manila replenishment visit.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies and confirms a December 10 telephone communication.

subfiles.title: War Department response on December Ondo visit
subfiles.about: War arranged courtesies for Ondo's December Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports a December 11 cable to the Philippine Department and notice for the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for Sunosaki
subfiles.about: Sunosaki proposed replenishment visits to Manila and Iloilo.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval and customary courtesies for the transport commanded by Commander Hachiro Nakao.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visits: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Sunosaki proposed to visit Manila on February 2–5 and Iloilo on April 3–6.
subfiles.summary: Relays the replenishment schedule and War Department request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visits: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Sunosaki proposed replenishment visits to Manila and Iloilo.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War has no objection.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgment of Sunosaki visits
subfiles.about: State consulted federal departments about Sunosaki's Manila and Iloilo visits.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the itinerary and promises a further response on the proposed visits.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for Okinoshima
subfiles.about: Okinoshima proposed to replenish at Davao on February 16–20 while returning from Palau.
subfiles.summary: Names Captain Namizo Sato and Rear Admiral Giichi Miyata; requests approval and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Okinoshima visit: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Okinoshima proposed a Davao replenishment visit on February 16–20.
subfiles.summary: Relays the itinerary and War Department request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Okinoshima visit: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Okinoshima proposed a Davao replenishment visit while returning from Palau.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War has no objection.

subfiles.title: State Department acknowledgment of Okinoshima visit
subfiles.about: State consulted federal authorities about Okinoshima's Davao visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the proposed replenishment stop and officers aboard. The Secretary promises a later decision on the visit and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy telephone response on Sunosaki
subfiles.from: Division of International Conferences and Protocol
subfiles.about: Navy had no objection to Sunosaki's visits.
subfiles.summary: Records Commander Hill's telephone response and planned notice to the Embassy.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Sunosaki
subfiles.about: War arranged courtesies for Sunosaki's Manila and Iloilo visits.
subfiles.summary: Reports a cable to the Philippine Department and notice for the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Signed copy of War Department response on Sunosaki
subfiles.from: Harry H. Woodring, Secretary of War
subfiles.about: War arranged courtesies for Sunosaki's Manila and Iloilo visits.
subfiles.summary: Signed copy of the War Department letter reporting instructions to Philippine authorities.

subfiles.title: Approval of Sunosaki visits
subfiles.about: The United States approved Sunosaki's Manila and Iloilo visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone notice to the Embassy and arrangements for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Okinoshima
subfiles.about: War arranged courtesies for Okinoshima's Davao visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports a cable to the Philippine Department and notice for the U.S. High Commissioner.

subfiles.title: Approval of Okinoshima visit
subfiles.about: The United States approved Okinoshima's Davao visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports instructions to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Delayed arrival of Okinoshima
subfiles.about: Okinoshima's arrival at Davao changed from February 16 to February 17.
subfiles.summary: Notifies State of the one-day delay.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Okinoshima delay
subfiles.about: Federal departments were advised of Okinoshima's delayed arrival.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the revised February 17 arrival date.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for training squadron visit
subfiles.about: Yakumo and Iwate, commanded by Vice Admiral Mineichi Koga, proposed to visit Manila on June 18–21.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval and customary courtesies for the ships and personnel.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of training squadron request
subfiles.from: Sumner Welles, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: State consulted federal authorities about the training squadron's Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the request and promises a further answer.

subfiles.title: Training squadron: request to War Department
subfiles.about: Yakumo and Iwate proposed to visit Manila on June 18–21.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if War has no objection.

subfiles.title: Training squadron: notice to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Yakumo and Iwate proposed a Manila visit under Vice Admiral Mineichi Koga.
subfiles.summary: Relays the visit and War Department request for customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Approval of training squadron visit
subfiles.from: Sumner Welles, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: The United States approved the training squadron's Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports that customary courtesies will be extended to Yakumo and Iwate.

subfiles.title: High Commissioner's inquiry about training squadron
subfiles.about: The U.S. High Commissioner asked whether the training squadron's Manila visit was approved.
subfiles.summary: Quotes McNutt's radiogram describing the squadron and its personnel.

subfiles.title: State Department reply to High Commissioner's inquiry
subfiles.about: State confirmed approval of the training squadron's Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges McNutt's inquiry and reports that federal departments and the Japanese Ambassador were advised.

subfiles.title: Navy Department response on training squadron
subfiles.from: William D. Leahy, Acting Secretary of the Navy
subfiles.about: Navy raised no objection to Yakumo and Iwate visiting Manila.
subfiles.summary: Reports plans to notify local naval authorities to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War Department response on training squadron
subfiles.about: War arranged courtesies for Yakumo and Iwate at Manila.
subfiles.summary: Reports radio instructions to the Philippine Department.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy request for Cavite Naval Base visit
subfiles.about: Training squadron officers and midshipmen wished to visit Cavite Naval Base on June 21.
subfiles.summary: Requests approval and customary courtesies for the personnel.

subfiles.title: Cavite visit: request to Navy Department
subfiles.about: Japanese training squadron personnel proposed to visit Cavite Naval Base.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies if Navy has no objection.

subfiles.title: Cavite visit: notice to War Department
subfiles.about: Japanese training squadron personnel proposed a June 21 visit to Cavite Naval Base.
subfiles.summary: Reports that Navy has been asked to arrange customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Cavite visit request
subfiles.about: State consulted federal authorities about the proposed Cavite visit.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the request and promises a further answer.

subfiles.title: War Department clarification on squadron arrangements
subfiles.about: War confirmed earlier instructions for courtesies during the squadron's Manila visit.
subfiles.summary: Explains that the Philippine Department was instructed on June 4 to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy Department approval of Cavite visit
subfiles.about: Navy raised no objection to the officers' and midshipmen's visit to Cavite.
subfiles.summary: Reports that local naval authorities were notified.

subfiles.title: Notice of Navy approval for Cavite visit
subfiles.about: Navy approved the training squadron personnel's Cavite visit.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone notice to the Embassy and notification of Philippine naval authorities.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Cavite visit
subfiles.about: War forwarded information about the Cavite visit to Philippine authorities.
subfiles.summary: Explains that Cavite Naval Base falls under Navy jurisdiction and reports radiogram notice to the Philippine Department.
